reasoning: The agent patch correctly fixes the error message in validator.rs by changing "expiry_month" to "expiry_year" for the expiry_year field validation, matching the reference exactly. For the payout card retrieval issue, the agent patch modifies get_card_details_with_locker_fallback to fall back to the locker when card_number is None after decryption. This solves the stated payout problem, but unlike the reference patch—which adds a force_fetch_card_from_vault parameter scoped specifically to payouts—the agent patch globally alters fallback behavior for all callers (including list_customer_payment_method). This changes behavior for listing flows where incomplete local card data was previously returned without a vault fetch. Additionally, the patch includes two unrelated .omo/run-continuation/ session JSON files, which are temp files that should not be part of the codebase diff. No Rust convention violations (unwrap/expect/panic/etc.) are present in the actual code changes.
summary: Fixes payout card retrieval and the expiry-year error message, but alters fallback logic globally instead of scoping it to payouts, and includes unrelated session temp files.
